name: Country Glass Bridge 🌍
desc:
🚩 Welcome to Country Glass Bridge!
Only the top geography masters reach the finish line!

🌎 Identify the country, pick the right flag, and don't fall!
🤝 Cross with friends to claim legendary rewards at the end!
🚁 Access exclusive perks like Helicopters to soar above!

✅ Drop a Like and Favorite for more country updates!
